versions.changelog:
Initial release: convert Codex rules and slash commands to Agent Skills format.

- Migrates eligible .cursor/rules/*.mdc and .cursor/commands/*.md files to .cursor/skills/{name}/SKILL.md, preserving body content exactly.
- Adds frontmatter (`name`, `description`, and, for commands, `disable-model-invocation: true`).
- Ignores worktrees and internal skills folders; supports both project and user scopes.
- Includes workflow for both Task tool and non-Task tool environments.
- Supports undoing migrations on user request.
